headline: Cheap for a bank, trading near highs
chart_note: 52-week range: $279.10 - $366.50. Currently $358.64, close to its 52-week high.
why_today: JPMorgan continues grinding toward its 52-week high, backed by resilient earnings from the largest US bank by assets. At 15.2x earnings, it remains cheap relative to the broader market despite the run-up.
pro_1: 13 of 14 analysts rate it Buy, and a PE of 15.2x is still modest for a bank this size and quality
pro_2: Trading near its 52-week high shows sustained investor confidence through the year
con_1: Average price target of $374.57 implies only about 4% upside - the easy gains may be behind it
con_2: Bank earnings remain sensitive to interest rate moves and credit cycle turns
